title: vshulcz/deja-vu
claim: vshulcz/deja-vu — Your agents already solved this. deja finds it — memory operations for seventeen coding agents: retroactive search and M
why_good: Shared memory across seventeen coding agents — 'your agents already solved this' — so work isn't re-done, via retroactive search + MCP recall.
value: Sell a hosted cross-agent memory service + team sync to shops juggling multiple coding agents; usage-based.
